info.title: Rigbox Managed AI Proxy
info.description:
The managed AI proxy reachable at `http://172.16.0.1:9090` from inside a workspace VM. It is **IP-attested** (no API key — send a placeholder `Authorization: Bearer managed-by-rigbox`) and exposes an OpenAI-compatible `/v1` surface over OpenRouter.

This reference documents the multi-tenant metering surface: the settled cost returned on each response, per-subject cost attribution and the rolling-window read, and per-subject budget + rate-limit enforcement. The proxy is the *mechanism*; your app owns *policy* (which tiers exist, the amounts, the windows) and asserts the end-user ("subject") id over the IP-attested channel.

tags.name: Managed Proxy
tags.description: Per-subject cost metering, attribution, and budget/rate-limit enforcement for multi-tenant apps.

post.description:
OpenAI-compatible chat completion through the managed proxy.

**Cost in the response:** the settled rigbox-credit cost rides on the response — the `X-Rigbox-Cost-Micro` / `X-Rigbox-Cost-Credits` headers and the `usage.cost_micro` / `usage.cost_credits` body fields (and, for streaming, the final `stream_options.include_usage` chunk). No second `/v1/generation` round-trip. Cost fields are best-effort: present only when upstream reports a cost — absence is not zero.

**Attribution:** set `X-Rigbox-Subject` (wins) or the OpenAI `user` body field to attribute the call to one of your end-users.

**Enforcement:** attach `X-Rigbox-Subject-Budget` and/or `X-Rigbox-Subject-Rate` to have the proxy reject the call (before any spend) once the subject is over its declared cap.

Scope: the same applies to `/v1/completions`, `/v1/responses`, and `/v1/embeddings`. `/v1/messages` (Anthropic) and the audio endpoints are not yet metered per-subject.

parameters.name: X-Rigbox-Subject
parameters.description: End-user id this call's cost is attributed to. Wins over the OpenAI `user` body field. Trimmed; empty is treated as absent; capped at 256 characters.

parameters.name: X-Rigbox-Subject-Budget
parameters.description: At most one. Total spend cap for the subject over a rolling window: `<amount>;period=<window>`. `<amount>` is credits (a float) or a request count with a `req` suffix (e.g. `100req`). `<window>` is `5h`/`30m`/`7d` or a bare number of seconds. Requires `X-Rigbox-Subject`. A breach returns `402 subject_over_budget`. Malformed → `400 subject_limit_malformed`.

parameters.name: X-Rigbox-Subject-Rate
parameters.description: May be sent multiple times. A sliding rolling-window rate limit for the subject: `<amount>;window=<window>` (same amount/window grammar as the budget header). Requires `X-Rigbox-Subject`. A breach returns `429 subject_rate_limited` with a `Retry-After` header. Malformed → `400 subject_limit_malformed`.

200.description: Chat completion. Carries the settled cost in both headers and the body `usage`.

X-Rigbox-Cost-Micro.description: Settled cost in microcredits (1,000,000 micro = 1 credit). Present only when upstream reported a cost.

X-Rigbox-Cost-Credits.description: Settled cost in credits (1 credit ≈ $0.01). Present only when upstream reported a cost.

error.message: Malformed X-Rigbox-Subject-Budget/-Rate header: expected '<amount>;period=<window>' (amount is credits, or a request count with a 'req' suffix).

402.description: The subject is over its declared budget. No spend occurs.

error.message: Subject 'tenant-42' is over its budget: 50 credits per 2592000s.

429.description: The subject hit a declared rate limit. No spend occurs.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before retrying (conservative upper bound — the window length).

error.message: Subject 'tenant-42' hit a rate limit: 5 credits per 3600s.

get.summary: Read a subject's rolling AI spend
get.description: Per-subject AI spend over a rolling window, served directly by the proxy from inside the VM. Scoped to the calling workspace's owner — you can only read your own subjects, and subjects are isolated from each other. Attribution is forward-only: only calls made after this feature shipped carry a subject.

parameters.name: subject
parameters.description: The end-user id (the value sent as `X-Rigbox-Subject` / OpenAI `user`).

parameters.name: window
parameters.description: Rolling window: `30s`/`15m`/`5h`/`7d` or a bare number of seconds. Defaults to `86400` (24h).

200.description: The subject's usage over the window.

ChatCompletionRequest.description: A standard OpenAI chat-completion request. Any OpenAI/OpenRouter field is forwarded verbatim; only the fields below are highlighted.

model.description: OpenRouter model slug — choose the upstream provider here.

stream.description: When true, the settled cost is appended to the final `usage` chunk (`stream_options.include_usage` is forced on).

user.description: OpenAI end-user field. Used as the subject when `X-Rigbox-Subject` is absent.

Usage.description: Token usage plus the rigbox-credit settled cost.

cost_micro.description: Settled rigbox cost in microcredits (1,000,000 micro = 1 credit). Present only when upstream reported a cost.

cost_credits.description: Settled rigbox cost in credits (1 credit ≈ $0.01). Present only when upstream reported a cost.

ChatCompletionResponse.description: A standard OpenAI chat-completion response; `usage` is augmented with the settled cost.

SubjectUsage.description: A subject's aggregated AI usage over a rolling window.

SubjectLimitError.description: Enforcement reject. OpenAI SDKs read `error.message`/`error.code`; `error.details` is the structured payload for your own UX.

used.description: Spend so far in the window — `{credits, credits_micro}` for a credit limit, `{requests}` for a request-count limit.

resets_at.description: Conservative upper bound on when the window clears (now + window length).
